requirements.name: 1 validity
requirements.detail: solids 1, shells 1, closed True, valid True, strict True, faces 4

requirements.name: 1 extent
requirements.detail: height (Z) above the root 280.000001 mm vs spec 280.000 (diff 9.23e-07); volume 368159.316 mm3 (cap adds 18123.063; OCCT default integration gives 368159.304)

requirements.name: 2 locked outline
requirements.detail: max outermost lip deviation 1.82e-06 mm over 101 cut planes; outline-to-surface max 9.01e-07 mm

requirements.name: 3 joins G1
requirements.detail: 2 edges, 798 samples: gap 2.30e-11 mm, angle 2.52e-05 deg; curvature mismatch 1.364e-04 /mm (cross-join normal curvature 1.363e-04 /mm); closest sample to an edge end 0.00025 mm, 56 samples near collapsed corners not judged

requirements.name: 4 section rule
requirements.detail: 24 cuts (0 failed to trace); thick zone min radius 0.102167 mm at x/c 0.99 (7 of 12 below 0.4); thin zone min ratio 0.03218 at x/c 0.99999399, t 0.05 mm (12 of 12 below 0.9); 17 of the failing cuts cross the lip more than 60 deg from square; bending reversals 8 on 3 cuts

requirements.name: 4b lip-normal radius (informational)
requirements.detail: radius across the lip, perpendicular to the locked outline, at each cut's lip point; thick zone min 0.5766 mm at x/c 0.97 (0 below 0.4); thin zone min ratio 1.491 at x/c 0.99845976 (0 below 0.9)

requirements.name: 5 whole-cap map
requirements.detail: worst point radius 0.576541 mm at x/c 0.967317, t 3.627 mm, margin 0.1765 mm; tightest 0.576541 mm at x/c 0.967317; points within 0.05 mm of collapsed corners not judged (grid reaches 0.0012 mm; worst there 0.618 mm, score 13.9)

requirements.name: 6 TE closure
